headline: Linn of Mercy Ignites With Base Battles as Stonecradle Clashes Escalate
war_summary: Direct base fighting has shifted decisively into Linn of Mercy, where three strategic transitions struck around Lathair over the past two hours, driving combined casualties past five hundred as Warden losses surged. This sharp outbreak contrasts with the Dead Lands, which has cooled to a near-standstill with negligible skirmishing following its earlier upheavals at Callahan's Gate. Meanwhile, tremendous bloodshed persists unabated across Stonecradle and the Weathered Expanse. Stonecradle saw nearly two thousand casualties over the past two hours under accelerating combat rates, while the Weathered Expanse recorded more than seventeen hundred fallen in the same span, though strategic fortifications in both sectors have held firm since dawn. To the north, Callahan's Passage is reawakening with four hundred fifty-five casualties in two hours, whereas the grinding attritional struggle in Nevish Line has cooled considerably. Peripheral theaters, including Mooring County and the Stlican Shelf, report steady frontlines with no strategic base turnover recorded during the past six hours.
